findings.title: Two workers can claim the same job (read-then-update race)
findings.rationale: The pending row is read, then updated in a separate await with no condition on status. Two concurrent claimNext calls both read job 'a' before either writes, so both return it. README says each job must be claimed by exactly one worker.

findings.title: Two workers can claim the same job: update() does not re-check the job is still pending
findings.rationale: The write overwrites claimedBy unconditionally; a job claimed by another worker in the meantime is silently re-assigned.

findings.title: listClaimedBy fetches jobs one at a time
findings.evidence:

findings.rationale: Sequential awaits inside the loop: N round-trips for N ids. A batch read or Promise.all would cut wall time. No benchmark exists, so any speed-up is an unverified hypothesis.
